messages:
Maria (CS): quick heads-up — EmberCore's latency p95 has crept from 210ms -> 460ms over the last 48h on /generate. customer is on redwood-hosted, using default routing to redwood-v2-medium. thinking we should proactively propose a low-risk perf plan: quantized variant + routing override to eu-west for traffic shaping. cc @Nate (Solutions)
Jamal (Eng): saw that in the dashboard this morning. interesting spike aligns with longer sequences (avg tokens/request +40%). quantization looks safe — we have redwood-v2-medium-q4 tested for seq<=1024 with <2% quality delta in our evals.
Olivia (ML): +1 for q4 but want to run quick prompt set eval for EmberCore's top 50 templates. will take ~30m if Jamal can snapshot a stable model candidate. we should include a canary rollout (5% -> 25%) and monitor perplexity + topk diffs.
Nate (Solutions): I'll own customer comms and enablement. suggested message: "We recommend a temporary route to redwood-v2-medium-q4 with a canary. We'll run targeted evals and monitor quality — rollback if regressions." also propose a 30-min enablement call tomorrow 10:30am PT. EmberCore renewal in 6 weeks so want to reduce churn risk.
Maria (CS): perfect. can you draft the enablement invite and add the eval checklist? I'll loop in the account exec. InfraBot, can you post the current routing config and last 24h error rates?
InfraBot: Routing snapshot: {default: redwood-v2-medium, backup: redwood-v2-small}. 24h error rate: 0.03% (unchanged). avg token length increased 42%. unusual peak windows: 03:00-05:00 UTC and 14:00-15:00 UTC.
Jamal (Eng): putting together a candidate artifact now. config diff for temporary route (to apply as a policy):
```yaml
route_policy:
  override_for_account: embercore
  percentage: 5
  model: redwood-v2-medium-q4
  rollout: canary
  monitor: [latency_p95, topk_similarity]
```
I'll also pack a quant parameters note: INT8 per-channel, fallback to FP16 on failure.
Olivia (ML): once Jamal drops the candidate, I'll run the EmberCore prompt set eval and post a brief report (pass/fail + examples). aim to have it before the invite goes out.
Nate (Solutions): invite draft posted to EmberCore thread, provisional time added. Maria — can you confirm internal exec in the next 2 hours so I can finalize?
Maria (CS): confirmed, looping in AE. next steps: 1) Jamal uploads candidate artifact, 2) Olivia runs eval, 3) Nate runs enablement call with customer and toggles canary, 4) monitor for 48h then decide broader swap. tagging this as proactive-perf-nudge :rocket:
Jamal (Eng): uploading artifact now. will notify when ready.
Olivia (ML): eval queued. will post results as a short summary.
Maria (CS): thanks all — keeping this low friction for the customer. I'll capture feedback in the CRM after the call. :thumbsup:
